note: Recorded from the hand-written pack. Every expectation describes that pack, not the real service. The recording covers the pack's expressible surface only: CreateStack, UpdateStack, ExecuteChangeSet, ValidateTemplate, GetTemplateSummary and ListExports are the template engine (parsing, intrinsic functions, cross-service provisioning, blob reads) and are the bundle's shadow reason. The stack records here are written by the rollback family, so Resources and Outputs are always empty.

steps.superseded: CancelUpdateStack answers StackId, which its Unit output shape does not declare; the bundle writes the record the same way and answers the declared empty body.
ContinueUpdateRollback answers StackId, which its output shape does not declare (no members); the bundle writes the record the same way and answers the declared empty body.
